destinationOptions.initTableSchemaDescription: Creates schemas, tables, and their constraints.
destinationOptions.onConflictDoNothingDescription: If there is a conflict when inserting data do not insert
destinationOptions.onConflictDoUpdateDescription: If there is a conflict when inserting data update the record
destinationOptions.skipForeignKeyViolationsDescription: Insert all valid records, bypassing any that violate foreign key constraints.
destinationOptions.maxInFlightDescription: The max number of batched records to have in flight at a given time. Increase to improve throughput.
destinationOptions.batchCountDatabaseDescription: The max allowed per batch before flushing to the database. 0 to disable count-based batching.
destinationOptions.batchCountS3Description: The max allowed per batch before flushing to S3. 0 to disable count-based batching.
destinationOptions.batchPeriodDescription: Time in which an incomplete batch should be flushed regardless of the count. Ex: 1s, 1m, 500ms. Empty to disable time-based batching (not recommended).
destinationOptions.storageClassDescription: The storage class that will be used when records are written to in S3
destinationOptions.uploadTimeoutDescription: The maximum period to wait on an upload before abandoning and re-attempting. Ex: 5s, 1m
destinationOptions.s3Description: Change how Husonym handles sending records to the bucket.

dynamodbSource.unmappedDescription: Set default transformers for any unmapped keys to automatically anonymize generic fields of data by data type.
dynamodbSource.readConsistencyDefault: Configures the read consistency, with the default being eventually consistent reads.
dynamodbSource.readConsistencyStrong: Strongly consistent ensures the most up to date data, reflecting updates from all prior successful write operations.
dynamodbSource.byteDescription: Set a default for unmapped Byte fields
dynamodbSource.booleanDescription: Set a default for unmapped Boolean fields

dynamodbSource.stringDescription: Set a default for unmapped String fields

schemaChange.title: When the source schema changes
schemaChange.description: A run compares the columns of the source with the mapping before it copies anything.

halt.label: Halt
halt.effect: The run stops and names the column, until someone maps it.

automap.label: Auto-map & review
automap.effect: The column is mapped as the PII detection suggests, or copied as it is when nothing fits. The change waits in Review until someone accepts it.

passthrough.label: Passthrough
passthrough.effect: The column is copied as it is, in clear, until someone maps it: personal data may reach the destination.

continue.label: Ignore
continue.effect: The column is left out of the copy. Writing fails if the destination column has no default.

halt.label: Halt
halt.effect: The run stops and names the column missing from the source.

continue.label: Continue
continue.effect: The run goes on without the column. Its mapping stays until it is removed in Mapping.
